components.name: Branching coral colony
components.function: Living coral animals, separate unmounted colony forms with visible base, realistic continuous branches/plate/fan. Gentle rose/cream/turquoise accents, not palace stone carvings. Taxonomy and biology unverified.
components.construction: One isolated branching coral colony. Living coral animals, separate unmounted colony forms with visible base, realistic continuous branches/plate/fan. Gentle rose/cream/turquoise accents, not palace stone carvings. Taxonomy and biology unverified. Coherent actual silhouette, visible root/underside/side; no unrelated architecture/scenery attached. Other existing named species/forms must not be regenerated. Local material consistent with source. Dimensions are proposals to refine by subject.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
